<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($rootScope) {

  /* =========================================================
     GATENOW · EACH PROJECT DETAIL · Client script

     The three action buttons are gone, so the form machinery
     that supported them has gone with them: openFormInline,
     closeActionForm, the two emits and the spUtil dependency.
     Dead code that still emits events is worse than no code,
     because the next person has to work out what is listening.

     What is left: leaving the page, and the tabs for the
     related records.

     If you want filing back on this page later, the pieces
     were: spUtil.get(widgetId, {project_id: ...}) to pull the
     form widget in, gn_child_form_toggled to tell the parent
     list a child form is up, and gn_close_action_form to let
     the form close itself.
     ========================================================= */

  var c = this;


  /* =====================================================
     LEAVING
     The parent list widget listens for this and puts itself
     back together.
     ===================================================== */

  c.goBack = function() {
    $rootScope.$emit('gn_close_project_details');
  };


  /* =====================================================
     RELATED RECORDS

     A tab only exists when it has something in it, and when
     the table behind it exists at all. An empty tab is a
     promise the record cannot keep.
     ===================================================== */

  c.tab = 'overview';

  /* Assigning c.tab straight from the template worked in
     principle and not in practice, because the tab button
     carried ng-repeat and ng-if on the same element. Both
     create a child scope and the pair is fragile enough that it
     is not worth debugging: the visible tabs are filtered here
     instead, and the switch goes through a function so there is
     one place to look when it misbehaves. */
  var ALL_TABS = [
    {
      key: 'overview', label: c.data.t.tabOverview,
      show: function() { return true; },
      count: function() { return 0; }
    },
    {
      key: 'reports', label: c.data.t.tabReports,
      show: function() { return c.data.counts.reports > 0; },
      count: function() { return c.data.counts.reports; }
    },
    {
      key: 'changes', label: c.data.t.tabChanges,
      show: function() { return c.data.counts.changes > 0; },
      count: function() { return c.data.counts.changes; }
    },
    {
      key: 'claims', label: c.data.t.tabClaims,
      show: function() { return c.data.counts.claims > 0; },
      count: function() { return c.data.counts.claims; }
    },
    {
      key: 'risks', label: c.data.t.tabRisks,
      show: function() { return c.data.hasRisks && c.data.counts.risks > 0; },
      count: function() { return c.data.counts.risks; }
    },
    {
      key: 'issues', label: c.data.t.tabIssues,
      show: function() { return c.data.hasIssues && c.data.counts.issues > 0; },
      count: function() { return c.data.counts.issues; }
    }
  ];

  /* only the tabs with something behind them */
  c.tabs = ALL_TABS.filter(function(t) {
    return t.show();
  });

  c.setTab = function(key) {
    if (!key || c.tab === key) return;

    /* never land on a tab that is not on screen */
    for (var i = 0; i < c.tabs.length; i++) {
      if (c.tabs[i].key === key) {
        c.tab = key;
        return;
      }
    }
  };

  c.isTab = function(key) {
    return c.tab === key;
  };

  /* if the record has no reports and the last project did, the
     tab from before would otherwise persist into a page that
     cannot render it */
  if (!c.isTab('overview')) {
    var stillThere = false;
    for (var ti = 0; ti < c.tabs.length; ti++) {
      if (c.tabs[ti].key === c.tab) stillThere = true;
    }
    if (!stillThere) c.tab = 'overview';
  }

  /* only the outcomes with something in them. Filtered here for
     the same reason as the tabs: ng-repeat and ng-if on one
     element is a pair worth avoiding. */
  c.changeStats = function() {
    return (c.data.changeStats || []).filter(function(st) {
      return st.count > 0;
    });
  };

  /* only the blocks that were actually filled in, so a sparse
     status report does not render eight empty headings */
  c.reportProse = function(r) {
    if (!r) return [];

    var rows = [
      { label: c.data.t.summary,   value: r.summary },
      { label: c.data.t.achieved,  value: r.achieved },
      { label: c.data.t.nextUp,    value: r.nextUp },
      { label: c.data.t.schedule,  value: r.cSchedule },
      { label: c.data.t.cost,      value: r.cCost },
      { label: c.data.t.resources, value: r.cResource },
      { label: c.data.t.scope,     value: r.cScope },
      { label: c.data.t.comments,  value: r.comments }
    ];

    return rows.filter(function(row) { return !!row.value; });
  };

};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* =========================================================
   GATENOW · EACH PROJECT DETAIL
   Service Portal widget · CSS / SCSS

   Selectors are written out in full. The Service Portal Sass
   compiler does not support parent selector concatenation.

   Same tokens as the projects list this opens from, so the
   handoff does not feel like arriving somewhere else.

   THE ANALYTIC THIS PAGE EXISTS FOR
   Delivery against the calendar. Two bars, schedule elapsed
   over work complete, and the gap between them is the whole
   story. Fifteen percent complete is fine in month one and
   alarming in month eleven, and no portfolio view can tell you
   which one you are looking at.

   The panel takes its border colour from that gap rather than
   from the self reported health, because a project can report
   green and still be four months behind.

   RED, AMBER, GREEN
   Kept, because the platform publishes health on that scale and
   reporting it in other colours would be its own kind of lie.
   Desaturated to sit inside the palette, and used only where
   health is being reported.
   ========================================================= */

/* ---------- typeface ---------- */

@font-face {
  font-family: "Outfit";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/x_enno_gatenow_outfit_regular.woff2") format("woff2");
}

@font-face {
  font-family: "Outfit";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/x_enno_gatenow_outfit_medium.woff2") format("woff2");
}

@font-face {
  font-family: "Outfit";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/x_enno_gatenow_outfit_semibold.woff2") format("woff2");
}

@font-face {
  font-family: "Outfit";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/x_enno_gatenow_outfit_bold.woff2") format("woff2");
}


/* ---------- ink ---------- */
$d-navy:   #0a2540;
$d-ink-2:  rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.72);
$d-ink-3:  rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.54);
$d-ink-4:  rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.38);
$d-line:   rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.10);
$d-line-2: rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.06);
$d-tint:   rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.03);

/* ---------- accent ---------- */
$d-blue:    #1560e0;
$d-blue-dk: #0f4cbb;
$d-blue-1:  rgba(21, 96, 224, 0.08);
$d-blue-2:  rgba(21, 96, 224, 0.16);

/* ---------- health ---------- */
$d-green:   #1f8a63;
$d-green-1: rgba(31, 138, 99, 0.12);
$d-amber:   #a4741f;
$d-amber-1: rgba(164, 116, 31, 0.12);
$d-red:     #b8394a;
$d-red-1:   rgba(184, 57, 74, 0.10);
$d-red-2:   rgba(184, 57, 74, 0.26);

$d-white: #ffffff;
$d-page:  #f4f6fb;
$d-ease:  cubic-bezier(0.45, 0.05, 0.25, 1);

$d-font: "Outfit", "Segoe UI", Roboto, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;


/* =========================================================
   PAGE
   ========================================================= */

.gpd {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 26px 34px 64px;
  background: $d-page;
  font-family: $d-font;
  color: $d-navy;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

.gpd *,
.gpd *::before,
.gpd *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }


/* =========================================================
   BACK
   ========================================================= */

.gpd-back {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  height: 34px;
  padding: 0 13px 0 8px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: transparent;
  color: $d-ink-3;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.35s $d-ease, color 0.35s $d-ease;
}

.gpd-back:hover {
  background: $d-tint;
  color: $d-navy;
}

.gpd-back__arrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid $d-line;
  transition: transform 0.35s $d-ease, border-color 0.35s $d-ease;
}

.gpd-back:hover .gpd-back__arrow {
  transform: translateX(-3px);
  border-color: $d-blue-2;
}

.gpd-back:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid $d-blue;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}


/* =========================================================
   MASTHEAD
   ========================================================= */

.gpd-top {
  position: relative;
  padding: 20px 26px 24px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  border: 1px solid $d-line;
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: $d-white;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.03);
}

/* the state, stated before any text is read */
.gpd-top__edge {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 3px;
  transform-origin: left center;
}

.gpd-top--green .gpd-top__edge {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, $d-green 0%, rgba(31, 138, 99, 0.3) 100%);
}

.gpd-top--amber .gpd-top__edge {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, $d-amber 0%, rgba(164, 116, 31, 0.3) 100%);
}

.gpd-top--red .gpd-top__edge {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, $d-red 0%, rgba(184, 57, 74, 0.3) 100%);
}

.gpd-top--none .gpd-top__edge {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.24) 0%, rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.06) 100%);
}

/* the action buttons that used to sit on the right are gone,
   so the row is one column and the title takes the width it
   needs rather than being held to a column that no longer has
   anything opposite it */
.gpd-top__row {
  margin: 16px 0 22px;
}

.gpd-top__lead { min-width: 0; flex: 1; }

.gpd-top__meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.gpd-health {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.gpd-health__dot {
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.gpd-health--green { color: $d-green; }
.gpd-health--amber { color: $d-amber; }
.gpd-health--red   { color: $d-red; }
.gpd-health--none  { color: $d-ink-4; }

.gpd-health--green .gpd-health__dot { background: $d-green; }
.gpd-health--amber .gpd-health__dot { background: $d-amber; }
.gpd-health--red .gpd-health__dot   { background: $d-red; }
.gpd-health--none .gpd-health__dot  {
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.28);
}

.gpd-health--sm { margin-left: auto; }

.gpd-top__tags {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd-top__sep { color: rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.22); }

.gpd .gpd-title {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 34ch;
  font-size: 30px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.16;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: $d-navy;
}

.gpd .gpd-lead {
  max-width: 74ch;
  margin: 11px 0 0;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.62;
  color: $d-ink-3;
  white-space: pre-line;
}

/* ---------- phase ---------- */

.gpd-phase {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}

.gpd-phase__step { min-width: 0; }

.gpd-phase__bar {
  display: block;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: $d-line-2;
  transform-origin: left center;
}

.gpd-phase__name {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 7px;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd-phase__step.is-done .gpd-phase__bar { background: rgba(21, 96, 224, 0.35); }
.gpd-phase__step.is-done .gpd-phase__name { color: $d-ink-3; }

.gpd-phase__step.is-now .gpd-phase__bar { background: $d-blue; }

.gpd-phase__step.is-now .gpd-phase__name {
  color: $d-blue-dk;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.gpd-phase.is-stopped .gpd-phase__bar { background: rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.14); }
.gpd-phase.is-stopped .gpd-phase__name { color: $d-ink-4; }


/* =========================================================
   TILES
   ========================================================= */

.gpd-tiles {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.gpd-tile {
  position: relative;
  padding: 18px 20px 20px;
  border: 1px solid $d-line;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: $d-white;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.03);
}

.gpd-tile__rule {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: $d-blue-2;
  transform-origin: left center;
}

.gpd-tile.is-alert .gpd-tile__rule { background: rgba(164, 116, 31, 0.34); }

.gpd .gpd-tile__label {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd .gpd-tile__value {
  margin: 11px 0 0;
  font-size: 26px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.06;
  letter-spacing: -0.032em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-navy;
}

.gpd .gpd-tile__note {
  margin: 7px 0 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: $d-ink-3;
}

.gpd-tile.is-alert .gpd-tile__note {
  color: $d-amber;
  font-weight: 500;
}


/* =========================================================
   PANELS
   ========================================================= */

.gpd-panel {
  padding: 20px 22px 22px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  border: 1px solid $d-line;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: $d-white;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.03);
}

.gpd-panels {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.gpd-panels .gpd-panel { margin-bottom: 0; }

.gpd-panel__head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px 22px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.gpd .gpd-panel__title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.014em;
  color: $d-navy;
}

.gpd .gpd-panel__hint {
  margin: 5px 0 0;
  max-width: 66ch;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd .gpd-panel__hint--tight { margin: -6px 0 14px; }

.gpd .gpd-panel__empty {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 26px 0 6px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd .gpd-sub {
  margin: 26px 0 12px;
  padding-top: 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid $d-line-2;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: $d-blue;
}


/* =========================================================
   DELIVERY AGAINST THE CALENDAR
   The panel takes its border from the gap between the two
   bars, not from the self reported health. A project can
   report green and still be four months behind.
   ========================================================= */

.gpd-panel--press { border-left: 3px solid $d-line; }

.gpd-panel--press.is-even  { border-left-color: $d-blue; }
.gpd-panel--press.is-ahead { border-left-color: $d-green; }
.gpd-panel--press.is-watch { border-left-color: $d-amber; }
.gpd-panel--press.is-late  { border-left-color: $d-red; }

.gpd-verdict {
  padding: 6px 13px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: $d-tint;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: $d-ink-2;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.gpd-panel--press.is-ahead .gpd-verdict { background: $d-green-1; color: $d-green; }
.gpd-panel--press.is-watch .gpd-verdict { background: $d-amber-1; color: $d-amber; }
.gpd-panel--press.is-late .gpd-verdict  { background: $d-red-1;   color: $d-red; }

.gpd-press {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}

.gpd-press__row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 138px minmax(0, 1fr) 48px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
}

.gpd-press__label {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: $d-ink-2;
}

.gpd-press__track {
  display: block;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: $d-tint;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.gpd-press__fill {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 7px;
  transform-origin: left center;
}

/* time is neutral, work is the accent. The reader is comparing
   two lengths, so only one of them needs to carry weight. */
.gpd-press__fill--time { background: rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.22); }
.gpd-press__fill--work { background: $d-blue; }

.gpd-panel--press.is-late .gpd-press__fill--work  { background: $d-red; }
.gpd-panel--press.is-watch .gpd-press__fill--work { background: $d-amber; }
.gpd-panel--press.is-ahead .gpd-press__fill--work { background: $d-green; }

.gpd-press__pct {
  text-align: right;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-navy;
}

.gpd .gpd-press__foot {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}


/* =========================================================
   TWELVE MONTH STRIP
   ========================================================= */

.gpd-strip {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 5px;
}

.gpd-strip__cell { min-width: 0; }

.gpd-cell {
  display: block;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: transform 0.3s $d-ease;
}

.gpd-cell:hover { transform: scale(1.08); }

.gpd-cell--green { background: $d-green; }
.gpd-cell--amber { background: $d-amber; }
.gpd-cell--red   { background: $d-red; }

/* absence, drawn as an outline rather than a fourth status */
.gpd-cell--none {
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px $d-line;
}

.gpd-strip__month {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-align: center;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}


/* =========================================================
   PROGRESS AS REPORTED
   A dot per report at the percent it claimed. A run of dots at
   the same height is a project that stopped moving, which no
   single figure shows.
   ========================================================= */

.gpd-line {
  position: relative;
  height: 132px;
  margin: 6px 6px 0;
}

.gpd-line__rule {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  height: 1px;
  background: $d-line-2;
}

.gpd-line__rule--mid  { top: 50%; }
.gpd-line__rule--base { top: auto; bottom: 0; background: $d-line; }

.gpd-dot {
  position: absolute;
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  margin: -5px 0 -5px -5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid $d-white;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.2);
  transition: transform 0.3s $d-ease;
}

.gpd-dot:hover { transform: scale(1.35); }

.gpd-dot--green { background: $d-green; }
.gpd-dot--amber { background: $d-amber; }
.gpd-dot--red   { background: $d-red; }
.gpd-dot--none  { background: rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.32); }


/* =========================================================
   THE REPORT CARD

   Five full width bars split by RAG were replaced. With one
   report on file every bar was 100% of something, so the panel
   rendered five solid blocks of colour that looked alarming and
   told the reader nothing.

   A grid of small marks says the same thing honestly at any
   volume. Colour is carried by dots rather than fills, so an
   amber run draws the eye because it is unusual rather than
   because it is loud, and green recedes: nobody needs a wall of
   green to tell them things are fine.
   ========================================================= */

.gpd-card { min-width: 0; }

.gpd-card__head,
.gpd-card__row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 128px repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.gpd-card__head {
  padding-bottom: 9px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid $d-line-2;
}

.gpd-card__col {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.11em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-align: center;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd-card__row {
  padding: 9px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid $d-line-2;
}

.gpd-card__row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }

.gpd-card__when {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.11em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd-card__date {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  text-transform: none;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-navy;
}

.gpd-card__ref {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: none;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd-card__cell {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 5px;
}

.gpd-mark {
  display: block;
  width: 13px;
  height: 13px;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

/* green recedes, amber and red do not */
.gpd-mark--green {
  background: rgba(31, 138, 99, 0.28);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(31, 138, 99, 0.5);
}

.gpd-mark--amber { background: $d-amber; }
.gpd-mark--red   { background: $d-red; }

/* not rated is an outline, not a fourth colour */
.gpd-mark--none {
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.18);
}

.gpd-card__row--tally {
  border-bottom: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid $d-line;
  padding-top: 11px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.gpd-count {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  padding: 0 6px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.gpd-count--amber { background: $d-amber-1; color: $d-amber; }
.gpd-count--red   { background: $d-red-1;   color: $d-red; }

.gpd-count--clean {
  background: transparent;
  color: $d-ink-4;
  font-weight: 400;
}

/* the conclusion, so the panel says something rather than only
   showing something */
.gpd .gpd-verdict--foot {
  display: block;
  margin: 18px 0 0;
  padding-top: 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid $d-line-2;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: $d-ink-3;
  white-space: normal;
}


/* =========================================================
   MONEY
   ========================================================= */

.gpd-pipe {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px 22px;
}

.gpd-stage { min-width: 0; }

.gpd-stage__top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.gpd-stage__label {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: $d-ink-2;
}

.gpd-stage__count {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd-stage__track {
  display: block;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: $d-tint;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.gpd-stage__fill {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  transform-origin: left center;
}

/* blue lightens along the run and paid turns green, so the set
   reads as a journey with an end */
.gpd-stage--submitted .gpd-stage__fill { background: rgba(21, 96, 224, 0.4); }
.gpd-stage--review .gpd-stage__fill    { background: rgba(21, 96, 224, 0.62); }
.gpd-stage--approved .gpd-stage__fill  { background: $d-blue; }
.gpd-stage--paid .gpd-stage__fill      { background: $d-green; }

.gpd-stage__value {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 9px;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.024em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-navy;
}

.gpd-stage--paid .gpd-stage__value { color: $d-green; }

.gpd-stage.is-empty .gpd-stage__label,
.gpd-stage.is-empty .gpd-stage__value { color: $d-ink-4; }

.gpd-reject {
  padding: 5px 11px;
  border: 1px solid $d-red-2;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: $d-red-1;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-red;
  white-space: nowrap;
}


/* =========================================================
   CHANGE OUTCOMES
   ========================================================= */

/* Counts are counts. One change request rendered as a full
   width blue bar with a 1 in it was a lot of ink for one
   number, so they are chips, and only the ones with something
   in them are drawn. */

.gpd .gpd-stats {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 0 0 20px;
  padding: 0 0 18px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid $d-line-2;
  list-style: none;
}

.gpd .gpd-stats li {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 13px;
  border: 1px solid $d-line;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: $d-white;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: $d-ink-3;
}

.gpd-stats__label { white-space: nowrap; }

.gpd-stats__n {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: $d-navy;
}

/* only the one that needs an answer carries any colour */
.gpd .gpd-stats--wait {
  border-color: $d-blue-2;
  background: $d-blue-1;
}

.gpd .gpd-stats--wait .gpd-stats__label { white-space: nowrap; }

.gpd-stats__n { color: $d-blue-dk; }

.gpd .gpd-stats--good .gpd-stats__label { white-space: nowrap; }

.gpd-stats__n { color: $d-green; }
.gpd .gpd-stats--bad .gpd-stats__n  { color: $d-red; }

.gpd-bars {
  display: grid;
  gap: 11px;
}

.gpd-bar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(0, 1fr) 28px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 13px;
}

.gpd-bar__name {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: $d-ink-2;
}

.gpd-bar__track {
  display: block;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: $d-tint;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.gpd-bar__fill {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: $d-blue;
  transform-origin: left center;
}

.gpd-bar--2 .gpd-bar__fill { background: rgba(21, 96, 224, 0.7); }
.gpd-bar--3 .gpd-bar__fill { background: rgba(21, 96, 224, 0.52); }
.gpd-bar--4 .gpd-bar__fill { background: rgba(21, 96, 224, 0.38); }
.gpd-bar--5 .gpd-bar__fill { background: rgba(21, 96, 224, 0.28); }

.gpd-bar__count {
  text-align: right;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-navy;
}


/* =========================================================
   RELATED RECORDS
   ========================================================= */

.gpd-block {
  border: 1px solid $d-line;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: $d-white;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.03);
}

.gpd-tabs {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 0 22px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid $d-line-2;
  overflow-x: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.gpd-tab {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  height: 46px;
  padding: 0 15px;
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  background: transparent;
  color: $d-ink-3;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: color 0.35s $d-ease, border-color 0.35s $d-ease;
}

.gpd-tab:hover { color: $d-navy; }

/* Active is the only state that gets the rule and the accent.
   The screenshot showed Overview looking bold at the same time
   as Change requests carried the underline, which is two tabs
   claiming to be current. Hover no longer changes weight, so
   only one tab can ever look selected. */
.gpd-tab.is-on {
  border-bottom-color: $d-blue;
  color: $d-blue-dk;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.gpd-tab__label { display: inline-block; }

.gpd-tab__n {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd-tab:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid $d-blue;
  outline-offset: -2px;
}

.gpd-block__body { padding: 22px 24px 26px; }

.gpd .gpd-kvs {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 14px 30px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.gpd-kv { min-width: 0; }

.gpd .gpd-kv dt {
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd .gpd-kv dd {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: $d-navy;
  word-break: break-word;
}

/* said rather than left blank, so nobody wonders whether it
   failed to load */
.gpd .gpd-kv dd.is-blank {
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: italic;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd-prose { margin-top: 18px; }

.gpd .gpd-prose__label {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

/* the line breaks the author typed are kept */
.gpd .gpd-prose__text {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 76ch;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: $d-ink-2;
  white-space: pre-line;
}

.gpd .gpd-empty {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 44px 0;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}


/* ---------- a report ---------- */

.gpd-report {
  padding: 18px 20px 20px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  border: 1px solid $d-line;
  border-radius: 13px;
}

.gpd-report:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

.gpd-report__head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid $d-line-2;
}

.gpd-report__num {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-navy;
}

.gpd-report__type {
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: $d-blue-1;
  color: $d-blue-dk;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.gpd-report__date,
.gpd-report__pct {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd-report__pct {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: $d-navy;
}

/* four ratings side by side, so one red is visible without
   reading any of them */
.gpd-rag {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}

.gpd-rag__item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: $d-tint;
  border-left: 3px solid transparent;
}

.gpd-rag__item--green { background: $d-green-1; border-left-color: $d-green; }
.gpd-rag__item--amber { background: $d-amber-1; border-left-color: $d-amber; }
.gpd-rag__item--red   { background: $d-red-1;   border-left-color: $d-red; }

.gpd-rag__label {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.11em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd-rag__value {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: $d-navy;
}


/* ---------- a related item ---------- */

.gpd-item {
  padding: 15px 18px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  border: 1px solid $d-line;
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.gpd-item:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

.gpd-item__head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 9px;
}

.gpd-item__num {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-navy;
}

.gpd-item__amount {
  margin-left: auto;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-navy;
}

.gpd-item__date {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd .gpd-item__title {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: $d-navy;
}

.gpd .gpd-item__meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px 18px;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd .gpd-item__meta strong {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: $d-ink-2;
}

.gpd .gpd-item__text {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 76ch;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.62;
  color: $d-ink-3;
  white-space: pre-line;
}

/* a compact fact row for risks and issues, so probability,
   impact, rank and due date read across rather than down */
.gpd .gpd-facts {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px 26px;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  padding: 12px 0 0;
  border-top: 1px solid $d-line-2;
}

.gpd-fact {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.gpd .gpd-fact dt {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: $d-ink-4;
}

.gpd .gpd-fact dd {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $d-navy;
}

/* a due date that has gone past is worth saying out loud */
.gpd .gpd-fact dd.is-late { color: $d-red; }

.gpd-flag {
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border: 1px solid $d-red-2;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: $d-red-1;
  color: $d-red;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.gpd-pill {
  padding: 4px 11px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.gpd-pill--good { background: $d-green-1; color: $d-green; }
.gpd-pill--ok   { background: $d-blue-1;  color: $d-blue-dk; }
.gpd-pill--wait { background: $d-tint;    color: $d-ink-3; }
.gpd-pill--bad  { background: $d-red-1;   color: $d-red; }


/* =========================================================
   BUTTONS
   ========================================================= */

.gpd-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 40px;
  padding: 0 17px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background 0.4s $d-ease, border-color 0.4s $d-ease, color 0.4s $d-ease;
}

.gpd-btn--primary {
  background: $d-blue;
  border-color: $d-blue;
  color: $d-white;
}

.gpd-btn--primary:hover,
.gpd-btn--primary:focus {
  background: $d-blue-dk;
  border-color: $d-blue-dk;
  color: $d-white;
}

.gpd-btn--ghost {
  border-color: $d-line;
  color: $d-ink-2;
}

.gpd-btn--ghost:hover,
.gpd-btn--ghost:focus {
  border-color: $d-blue-2;
  color: $d-blue-dk;
}

.gpd-btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid $d-blue;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}


/* =========================================================
   NOT AVAILABLE
   ========================================================= */

.gpd-missing {
  max-width: 480px;
  margin: 60px auto;
  padding: 44px 30px 40px;
  border: 1px solid $d-line;
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: $d-white;
  text-align: center;
}

.gpd .gpd-missing__title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: $d-navy;
}

.gpd .gpd-missing__why {
  max-width: 42ch;
  margin: 10px auto 22px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: $d-ink-3;
}

/* nothing below the title means the button needs its own space */
.gpd .gpd-missing__title:last-of-type { margin-bottom: 22px; }


/* =========================================================
   MOTION
   ========================================================= */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {

  @keyframes gpdRise {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  @keyframes gpdDrawX {
    from { transform: scaleX(0); }
    to   { transform: scaleX(1); }
  }

  @keyframes gpdPop {
    0%   { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.4); }
    60%  { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.2); }

}]]></link><name>Each Project Detail</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles>x_enno_gatenow.service_applicant_user,x_enno_gatenow.grant_awards_user</roles><script><![CDATA[(function () {

  /* =========================================================
     GATENOW · EACH PROJECT DETAIL
     Service Portal widget · Server script

     Everything hanging off one project: status reports, change
     requests, reimbursements, risks and issues, with analytics
     that only make sense for a single project rather than a
     portfolio.

     The project comes in as options.project_id, which is what
     spUtil.get passes from the list widget. A sys_id in the URL
     is accepted too, so the page is linkable.

     Ownership is checked before anything is read. Being handed
     a sys_id is not the same as being entitled to it.
     ========================================================= */

  var APPLICANT = 'x_enno_gatenow_service_applicants';
  var PROJECT   = 'x_enno_gatenow_project';
  var REPORT    = 'x_enno_gatenow_status_report';
  var CLAIM     = 'x_enno_gatenow_reimbursement';

  var CHANGE_TABLES = ['x_enno_gatenow_request_change', 'x_enno_gatenow_change_request'];
  var RISK_TABLES   = ['x_enno_gatenow_risk', 'x_enno_gatenow_project_risk'];
  var ISSUE_TABLES  = ['x_enno_gatenow_issue', 'x_enno_gatenow_project_issue'];

  var me = gs.getUserID();

  function opt(name, fallback) {
    var v = options[name];
    return (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') ? fallback : v.toString();
  }

  function lower(v) {
    return (v === null || v === undefined) ? '' : ('' + v).toLowerCase().trim();
  }

  function toGDT(value) {
    if (!value) return null;
    var s = '' + value;
    if (s.length === 10) s += ' 00:00:00';
    try { return new GlideDateTime(s); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  function fmtDate(value) {
    var g = toGDT(value);
    if (!g) return '';
    try { return g.getDate().getByFormat('d MMM yyyy'); } catch (e) { return '' + value; }
  }

  function daysBetween(a, b) {
    var ga = toGDT(a);
    var gb = toGDT(b);
    if (!ga || !gb) return null;
    return Math.round((gb.getNumericValue() - ga.getNumericValue()) / 86400000);
  }

  function daysFromNow(value) {
    var g = toGDT(value);
    if (!g) return null;
    return Math.round((g.getNumericValue() - new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue()) / 86400000);
  }

  function num(raw) {
    if (raw === null || raw === undefined || raw === '') return 0;
    var s = '' + raw;
    if (s.indexOf(';') !== -1) s = s.split(';').pop();
    var n = parseFloat(s);
    return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
  }

  function commas(n) {
    var s = '' + Math.round(n);
    var out = '';
    var c = 0;
    for (var i = s.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      out = s.charAt(i) + out;
      c++;
      if (c % 3 === 0 && i > 0) out = ',' + out;
    }
    return out;
  }

  function money(n) { return n ? '$' + commas(n) : '$0'; }

  function short(n) {
    if (!n) return '$0';
    if (n >= 1000000) return '$' + (n / 1000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'M';
    if (n >= 1000)    return '$' + Math.round(n / 1000) + 'K';
    return '$' + commas(n);
  }

  function pick(gr, names) {
    for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
      try {
        if (gr.isValidField(names[i])) {
          var v = gr.getValue(names[i]);
          if (v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '') return v;
        }
      } catch (e) { /* next */ }
    }
    return '';
  }

  /* the long fields are HTML areas and raw markup was leaking
     into the list views */
  function text(raw, cap) {
    if (!raw) return '';
    var s = ('' + raw)
      .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n')
      .replace(/<\/p>/gi, '\n\n')
      .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '')
      .replace(/ /g, ' ')
      .replace(/&/g, '&')
      .replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
      .trim();
    if (cap && s.length > cap) s = s.substring(0, cap).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '') + '...';
    return s;
  }

  /* GlideRecord here rather than GlideRecordSecure, because
     isValid answers whether the table exists at all. No query
     runs and no data is read. */
  function firstValidTable(list) {
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      try {
        var probe = new GlideRecordSecure(list[i]);
        if (probe.isValid()) return list[i];
      } catch (e) { /* next */ }
    }
    return '';
  }

  function rag(value) {
    var v = lower(value);
    if (v.indexOf('red') !== -1)    return { key: 'red',   label: gs.getMessage('Red') };
    if (v.indexOf('yellow') !== -1) return { key: 'amber', label: gs.getMessage('Yellow') };
    if (v.indexOf('green') !== -1)  return { key: 'green', label: gs.getMessage('Green') };
    return { key: 'none', label: gs.getMessage('Not set') };
  }

  var CHANGE = firstValidTable(CHANGE_TABLES) || CHANGE_TABLES[0];
  var RISK   = firstValidTable(RISK_TABLES);
  var ISSUE  = firstValidTable(ISSUE_TABLES);

  data.hasRisks  = !!RISK;
  data.hasIssues = !!ISSUE;


  /* ============================================================
     WHICH PROJECT, AND MAY THEY SEE IT
     ============================================================ */

  /* Where the project id can arrive from.

     spUtil.get puts its second argument on options, but the
     same widget may be embedded through $sp.getWidget, opened
     from a link, or dropped on a page with an instance option.
     Reading one source and giving up is what produced the
     "Project not available" panel on a project the list had
     just shown, so every source is tried in turn and the one
     that answered is logged. */
  function resolveProjectId() {

    var tries = [];

    function consider(where, value) {
      if (value === null || value === undefined) return;
      var v = ('' + value).trim();
      /* a sys_id is 32 hex characters. Anything else is a
         placeholder that never got substituted. */
      if (v.length === 32) tries.push({ where: where, id: v });
    }

    try { consider('options.project_id', options.project_id); } catch (e) {}
    try { consider('options.sys_id',     options.sys_id); } catch (e) {}

    try {
      if (typeof input !== 'undefined' && input) {
        consider('input.project_id', input.project_id);
        consider('input.sys_id',     input.sys_id);
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    consider('url.project_id', $sp.getParameter('project_id'));
    consider('url.sys_id',     $sp.getParameter('sys_id'));

    return tries.length ? tries[0] : null;
  }

  var resolved = resolveProjectId();
  var projectId = resolved ? resolved.id : '';

  /* declared out here because the whole page below reads from it */
  var pj = new GlideRecordSecure(PROJECT);

  data.found  = false;
  data.error  = '';
  data.reason = '';

  if (!projectId) {

    data.reason = 'no_id';
    data.error = gs.getMessage('No project was passed to this page.');
    gs.warn('[ProjectDetail] no project id on any of options, input or the URL');

  } else {

    gs.info('[ProjectDetail] project ' + projectId + ' via ' + resolved.where);

    if (!pj.get(projectId)) {

      /* Either the record is gone, or the read ACL on the
         project table is refusing it. Those are different
         problems and the log says which. */
     var exists = false;
			var probe2 = new GlideRecordSecure(PROJECT);
			try {
				if (probe2.get(projectId)) {
					exists = true;
				}
			} catch (e) {}

      data.reason = exists ? 'no_read' : 'missing';
      data.error = exists
        ? gs.getMessage('You do not have read access to that project.')
        : gs.getMessage('That project no longer exists.');

      gs.warn('[ProjectDetail] ' + projectId + ' not readable by ' + gs.getUserName() +
              (exists ? ' (record exists, read ACL is refusing it)' : ' (record not found)'));

    } else {

      /* The project has to belong to one of this person's
         applications. Being handed a sys_id is not entitlement.

         An applicant record with no user on it is treated as
         not owned rather than as owned by everyone, and it is
         logged, because that is a data problem worth seeing
         rather than a hole worth leaving open. */
      var applicantId = pj.getValue('applicant');
      var owns = false;

      if (!applicantId) {
        gs.warn('[ProjectDetail] project ' + projectId + ' has no applicant set');
      } else {
        var ap0 = new GlideRecordSecure(APPLICANT);
        if (!ap0.get(applicantId)) {
          gs.warn('[ProjectDetail] applicant ' + applicantId + ' not readable');
        } else {
          var owner = ap0.getValue('user');
          if (!owner) {
            gs.warn('[ProjectDetail] applicant ' + applicantId + ' has no user set');
          } else if (owner === me) {
            owns = true;
          }
        }
      }

      if (!owns) {
        data.reason = 'not_yours';
        data.error = gs.getMessage('That project is not linked to one of your applications.');
        gs.warn('[ProjectDetail] ' + me + ' attempted to open ' + projectId);
      } else {
        data.found = true;
      }
    }
  }

  if (!data.found) {
    data.t = {
      missing: gs.getMessage('Project not available'),
      back   : gs.getMessage('Back to my projects')
    };
    return;
  }


  /* ============================================================
     THE PROJECT
     ============================================================ */

  var PHASES = ['initiating', 'planning', 'executing', 'delivering', 'closed complete'];

  data.phaseTrack = [
    gs.getMessage('Initiating'),
    gs.getMessage('Planning'),
    gs.getMessage('Executing'),
    gs.getMessage('Delivering'),
    gs.getMessage('Closed')
  ];

  function phaseIndex(label) {
    var v = lower(label);
    if (v.indexOf('cancel') !== -1) return -1;
    for (var i = 0; i < PHASES.length; i++) {
      if (v.indexOf(PHASES[i]) !== -1) return i;
    }
    if (v.indexOf('closed') !== -1) return 4;
    return 0;
  }

  var health = rag(pj.getDisplayValue('status'));
  var percent = parseInt(pj.getValue('percent_complete') || 0, 10) || 0;

  var actualStart  = pj.getValue('actual_start_date');
  var plannedStart = pj.getValue('planned_start_date');
  var actualEnd    = pj.getValue('actual_end_date');
  var plannedEnd   = pj.getValue('planned_end_date');

  data.project = {
    sys_id : pj.getUniqueValue(),
    number : pj.getValue('number'),
    name   : pick(pj, ['project_name', 'short_description']) || pj.getValue('number'),
    program: pj.getDisplayValue('program'),
    award  : pj.getDisplayValue('award'),
    applicant: pj.getDisplayValue('applicant'),
    manager: pj.getDisplayValue('program_manager'),
    description: text(pj.getValue('description')),
    notes  : text(pick(pj, ['notes', 'work_notes'])),

    phase      : pj.getDisplayValue('phase'),
    phaseIndex : phaseIndex(pj.getDisplayValue('phase')),
    health     : health.key,
    healthLabel: health.key === 'green' ? gs.getMessage('On track')
               : health.key === 'amber' ? gs.getMessage('At risk')
               : health.key === 'red'   ? gs.getMessage('Critical')
               : gs.getMessage('Not reported'),
    percent    : percent,

    actualStart : fmtDate(actualStart),
    plannedStart: fmtDate(plannedStart),
    actualEnd   : fmtDate(actualEnd),
    plannedEnd  : fmtDate(plannedEnd)
  };


  /* ============================================================
     SCHEDULE PRESSURE

     The one number that matters on a single project and that no
     portfolio view can show: how much of the time has gone
     against how much of the work is done.

     Fifteen percent complete is fine in month one and alarming
     in month eleven, and percent_complete on its own cannot
     tell you which you are looking at.
     ============================================================ */

  var startFor = actualStart || plannedStart;
  var endFor   = plannedEnd || actualEnd;

  data.pressure = null;

  if (startFor && endFor) {

    var totalDays = daysBetween(startFor, endFor);
    var goneDays  = daysBetween(startFor, new GlideDateTime().getValue());

    if (totalDays && totalDays > 0) {

      var elapsed = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round((goneDays / totalDays) * 100)));
      var gap = percent - elapsed;
      var left = daysFromNow(endFor);

      var verdict, tone;

      if (left !== null && left < 0) {
        tone = 'late';
        verdict = gs.getMessage('Past the planned end date') + ' ' +
                  gs.getMessage('by') + ' ' + Math.abs(left) + ' ' + gs.getMessage('days');
      } else if (gap <= -20) {
        tone = 'late';
        verdict = Math.abs(gap) + gs.getMessage(' points behind the calendar');
      } else if (gap <= -8) {
        tone = 'watch';
        verdict = Math.abs(gap) + gs.getMessage(' points behind the calendar');
      } else if (gap >= 8) {
        tone = 'ahead';
        verdict = gap + gs.getMessage(' points ahead of the calendar');
      } else {
        tone = 'even';
        verdict = gs.getMessage('Delivery is tracking the calendar');
      }

      data.pressure = {
        elapsed : elapsed,
        done    : percent,
        gap     : gap,
        tone    : tone,
        verdict : verdict,
        totalDays: totalDays,
        daysLeft: left,
        usedPlanned: !actualStart
      };
    }
  }


  /* ============================================================
     RELATED RECORDS
     ============================================================ */

  function relatedList(table, limit, mapper) {
    var out = [];
    if (!table) return out;
    try {
      var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(table);
      gr.addQuery('project', projectId);
      gr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
      gr.setLimit(limit);
      gr.query();
      while (gr.next()) out.push(mapper(gr));
    } catch (e) {
      gs.info('[ProjectDetail] ' + table + ': ' + e.message);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /* ---------- status reports ---------- */
  var monthNames = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun',
                    'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];

  var dims = {
    overall  : { green: 0, amber: 0, red: 0 },
    schedule : { green: 0, amber: 0, red: 0 },
    cost     : { green: 0, amber: 0, red: 0 },
    resources: { green: 0, amber: 0, red: 0 },
    scope    : { green: 0, amber: 0, red: 0 }
  };

  var reportByMonth = {};
  var progressLine = [];

  data.reports = relatedList(REPORT, 40, function (gr) {

    var raw = gr.getValue('status_date') || gr.getValue('sys_created_on');
    var mk = raw ? ('' + raw).substring(0, 7) : '';

    var h  = rag(gr.getValue('overall_health'));
    var sc = rag(gr.getValue('schedule'));
    var co = rag(gr.getValue('cost'));
    var re = rag(gr.getValue('resources'));
    var sp = rag(gr.getValue('scope'));

    if (dims.overall[h.key] !== undefined)   dims.overall[h.key]++;
    if (dims.schedule[sc.key] !== undefined) dims.schedule[sc.key]++;
    if (dims.cost[co.key] !== undefined)     dims.cost[co.key]++;
    if (dims.resources[re.key] !== undefined) dims.resources[re.key]++;
    if (dims.scope[sp.key] !== undefined)    dims.scope[sp.key]++;

    if (mk && !reportByMonth[mk]) reportByMonth[mk] = h.key;

    var pct = parseInt(gr.getValue('percent_complete') || 0, 10) || 0;
    if (raw) progressLine.push({ raw: raw, pct: pct, health: h.key });

    return {
      sysId  : gr.getUniqueValue(),
      number : gr.getValue('number'),
      date   : fmtDate(raw),
      rawDate: raw,
      period : mk ? (monthNames[parseInt(mk.substring(5, 7), 10) - 1] + ' ' + mk.substring(0, 4)) : '',
      type   : gr.getDisplayValue('report_status'),
      percent: pct,
      health : h,
      schedule : sc,
      cost     : co,
      resources: re,
      scope    : sp,
      summary  : text(gr.getValue('executive_summary')),
      comments : text(gr.getValue('comments')),
      achieved : text(gr.getValue('achievements_last_month')),
      nextUp   : text(gr.getValue('key_activities_next_month')),
      cSchedule: text(gr.getValue('comments_on_schedule')),
      cCost    : text(gr.getValue('comments_on_cost')),
      cResource: text(gr.getValue('resource_comments')),
      cScope   : text(gr.getValue('comments_on_scope'))
    };
  });

  /* ---------- change requests ---------- */
  var approval = { approved: 0, rejected: 0, requested: 0, notyet: 0 };
  var byCategory = {};

  data.changes = relatedList(CHANGE, 40, function (gr) {

    var appr = lower(gr.getDisplayValue('approval'));

    var state = appr.indexOf('approved') !== -1 ? 'good'
              : appr.indexOf('rejected') !== -1 ? 'bad'
              : (appr.indexOf('requested') !== -1 && appr.indexOf('not yet') === -1) ? 'wait'
              : 'draft';

    if (state === 'good')      approval.approved++;
    else if (state === 'bad')  approval.rejected++;
    else if (state === 'wait') approval.requested++;
    else                       approval.notyet++;

    var cat = gr.getDisplayValue('category') || gs.getMessage('Uncategorised');
    byCategory[cat] = (byCategory[cat] || 0) + 1;

    return {
      sysId   : gr.getUniqueValue(),
      number  : gr.getValue('number'),
      title   : pick(gr, ['title', 'short_description']),
      category: gr.getDisplayValue('category'),
      priority: gr.getDisplayValue('priority'),
      impact  : gr.getDisplayValue('impact'),
      approval: gr.getDisplayValue('approval'),
      state   : state,
      proposed: text(gr.getValue('proposed_change')),
      reason  : text(gr.getValue('reason_for_change')),
      raised  : fmtDate(gr.getValue('sys_created_on'))
    };
  });

  /* ---------- reimbursements ---------- */
  var claimValue = { submitted: 0, review: 0, approved: 0, paid: 0, rejected: 0 };
  var claimCount = { submitted: 0, review: 0, approved: 0, paid: 0, rejected: 0 };

  data.claims = relatedList(CLAIM, 40, function (gr) {

    var st = lower(gr.getDisplayValue('status'));
    var key = st.indexOf('paid') !== -1     ? 'paid'
            : st.indexOf('rejected') !== -1 ? 'rejected'
            : st.indexOf('approved') !== -1 ? 'approved'
            : st.indexOf('review') !== -1   ? 'review'
            : 'submitted';

    var amount = num(pick(gr, ['amount_requested']));

    claimValue[key] += amount;
    claimCount[key]++;

    return {
      sysId : gr.getUniqueValue(),
      number: gr.getValue('number'),
      status: gr.getDisplayValue('status'),
      state : key === 'paid' ? 'good' : key === 'rejected' ? 'bad'
            : key === 'approved' ? 'ok' : 'wait',
      key   : key,
      amount: amount,
      amountText: money(amount),
      from  : fmtDate(pick(gr, ['from'])),
      to    : fmtDate(pick(gr, ['to'])),
      summary: pick(gr, ['short_description']),
      raised: fmtDate(gr.getValue('sys_created_on'))
    };
  });

  /* ---------- risks ----------
     Fields taken from the risk form: probability, impact, due
     date, risk rank, risk status, short description,
     description and mitigation plan. The old mapper read four
     of those and threw the rest away, which is why the tab
     showed a title and nothing else. */
  data.risks = relatedList(RISK, 30, function (gr) {

    var status = gr.getDisplayValue('risk_status') || gr.getDisplayValue('state');
    var st = lower(status);
    var due = gr.getValue('due_date');
    var overdue = due ? (daysFromNow(due) !== null && daysFromNow(due) < 0) : false;

    var rank = parseInt(gr.getValue('risk_rank') || 0, 10) || 0;

    return {
      sysId   : gr.getUniqueValue(),
      number  : gr.getValue('number'),
      title   : pick(gr, ['short_description']),
      detail  : text(gr.getValue('description')),
      mitigation: text(pick(gr, ['mitigation_plan'])),

      probability: gr.getDisplayValue('probability'),
      impact  : gr.getDisplayValue('impact'),
      rank    : rank,
      status  : status,
      /* Mitigate, Accept and Avoid are all live. Only a closed
         or resolved risk is finished with. */
      open    : st.indexOf('closed') === -1 && st.indexOf('resolved') === -1,

      due     : fmtDate(due),
      overdue : overdue,
      raised  : fmtDate(gr.getValue('sys_created_on'))
    };
  });

  /* ---------- issues ----------
     A slightly different form: priority rather than probability,
     and no mitigation plan. */
  data.issues = relatedList(ISSUE, 30, function (gr) {

    var status = gr.getDisplayValue('state') || gr.getDisplayValue('status');
    var st = lower(status);
    var due = gr.getValue('due_date');
    var overdue = due ? (daysFromNow(due) !== null && daysFromNow(due) < 0) : false;

    return {
      sysId   : gr.getUniqueValue(),
      number  : gr.getValue('number'),
      title   : pick(gr, ['short_description']),
      detail  : text(gr.getValue('description')),

      priority: gr.getDisplayValue('priority'),
      impact  : gr.getDisplayValue('impact'),
      status  : status,
      open    : st.indexOf('closed') === -1 && st.indexOf('resolved') === -1,

      due     : fmtDate(due),
      overdue : overdue,
      raised  : fmtDate(gr.getValue('sys_created_on'))
    };
  });

  var openRisks = 0;
  for (var ri = 0; ri < data.risks.length; ri++) if (data.risks[ri].open) openRisks++;

  var openIssues = 0;
  for (var ii = 0; ii < data.issues.length; ii++) if (data.issues[ii].open) openIssues++;


  /* ============================================================
     ANALYTICS
     ============================================================ */

  /* ---------- reporting strip, twelve months ---------- */
  data.strip = [];

  for (var m = 11; m >= 0; m--) {
    var g = new GlideDateTime();
    g.addMonthsLocalTime(-m);
    var mi = g.getMonthLocalTime() - 1;
    var key = g.getYearLocalTime() + '-' + ('0' + (mi + 1)).slice(-2);

    data.strip.push({
      month: monthNames[mi],
      key  : reportByMonth[key] || 'none',
      first: mi === 0 || m === 11
    });
  }

  /* ---------- progress against reports ----------
     The percent complete each report claimed, in order. A line
     that flattens is a project that stopped moving, which no
     single figure shows. */
  progressLine.sort(function (a, b) { return ('' + a.raw).localeCompare('' + b.raw); });

  data.progress = [];
  var pmax = progressLine.length;

  for (var pl = 0; pl < progressLine.length; pl++) {
    data.progress.push({
      pct   : progressLine[pl].pct,
      health: progressLine[pl].health,
      x     : pmax > 1 ? Math.round((pl / (pmax - 1)) * 100) : 50,
      label : fmtDate(progressLine[pl].raw)
    });
  }

  data.hasProgress = data.progress.length > 1;

  /* ---------- the report card ----------

     Five full width bars, one per dimension, split by how often
     each was green, amber or red. With one report on file every
     bar was 100% of something, so the panel rendered five solid
     blocks of colour that looked alarming and said nothing.

     A grid says the same thing honestly at any volume: one row
     per report, one dot per dimension. At one report it is five
     dots. At twelve it is a pattern, and a column that keeps
     going amber is visible without reading a single label.

     Colour is carried by small dots rather than large fills, so
     an amber run draws the eye because it is unusual rather than
     because it is loud.
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  data.gridCols = [
    gs.getMessage('Overall'),
    gs.getMessage('Schedule'),
    gs.getMessage('Cost'),
    gs.getMessage('Resources'),
    gs.getMessage('Scope')
  ];

  data.grid = [];

  for (var gr2 = 0; gr2 < data.reports.length && gr2 < 12; gr2++) {
    var rep = data.reports[gr2];
    data.grid.push({
      number: rep.number,
      date  : rep.date,
      period: rep.period,
      cells : [
        { key: rep.health.key,    label: rep.health.label },
        { key: rep.schedule.key,  label: rep.schedule.label },
        { key: rep.cost.key,      label: rep.cost.label },
        { key: rep.resources.key, label: rep.resources.label },
        { key: rep.scope.key,     label: rep.scope.label }
      ]
    });
  }

  /* A tally under the grid, because counting dots is work the
     page can do for the reader. Green is not counted: nobody
     needs telling how often things were fine. */
  function tally(key) {
    var d = dims[key];
    return { amber: d.amber, red: d.red, clean: (d.amber + d.red) === 0 };
  }

  data.gridTally = [
    tally('overall'),
    tally('schedule'),
    tally('cost'),
    tally('resources'),
    tally('scope')
  ];

  data.hasGrid = data.reports.length > 0;

  /* the worst dimension, said in words, so the panel has a
     conclusion rather than only evidence */
  data.gridVerdict = '';

  if (data.reports.length) {

    var worst = null;
    var names = ['overall', 'schedule', 'cost', 'resources', 'scope'];
    var labels = data.gridCols;

    for (var wi = 1; wi < names.length; wi++) {
      var d2 = dims[names[wi]];
      var bad = (d2.red * 2) + d2.amber;
      if (bad > 0 && (worst === null || bad > worst.bad)) {
        worst = { label: labels[wi], bad: bad, red: d2.red, amber: d2.amber };
      }
    }

    if (!worst) {
      data.gridVerdict = gs.getMessage('Every dimension has reported green so far.');
    } else {
      data.gridVerdict = worst.label + ' ' + gs.getMessage('has needed attention most') +
        ' (' + (worst.red ? worst.red + ' ' + gs.getMessage('red') : '') +
        (worst.red && worst.amber ? ', ' : '') +
        (worst.amber ? worst.amber + ' ' + gs.getMessage('yellow') : '') + ')';
    }
  }

  /* ---------- money ---------- */
  var inFlight = claimValue.submitted + claimValue.review + claimValue.approved + claimValue.paid;

  data.money = {
    inFlight   : inFlight,
    inFlightText: short(inFlight),
    paid       : claimValue.paid,
    paidText   : short(claimValue.paid),
    waiting    : claimValue.submitted + claimValue.review,
    waitingText: short(claimValue.submitted + claimValue.review),
    rejected   : claimValue.rejected,
    rejectedText: short(claimValue.rejected),
    stages: [
      { key: 'submitted', label: gs.getMessage('Submitted'), count: claimCount.submitted,
        text: short(claimValue.submitted),
        width: inFlight ? Math.max(claimValue.submitted > 0 ? 4 : 0, Math.round((claimValue.submitted / inFlight) * 100)) : 0 },
      { key: 'review', label: gs.getMessage('In review'), count: claimCount.review,
        text: short(claimValue.review),
        width: inFlight ? Math.max(claimValue.review > 0 ? 4 : 0, Math.round((claimValue.review / inFlight) * 100)) : 0 },
      { key: 'approved', label: gs.getMessage('Approved'), count: claimCount.approved,
        text: short(claimValue.approved),
        width: inFlight ? Math.max(claimValue.approved > 0 ? 4 : 0, Math.round((claimValue.approved / inFlight) * 100)) : 0 },
      { key: 'paid', label: gs.getMessage('Paid'), count: claimCount.paid,
        text: short(claimValue.paid),
        width: inFlight ? Math.max(claimValue.paid > 0 ? 4 : 0, Math.round((claimValue.paid / inFlight) * 100)) : 0 }
    ]
  };

  data.hasMoney = data.claims.length > 0;

  /* ---------- change outcomes ---------- */
  var apprTotal = approval.approved + approval.rejected + approval.requested + approval.notyet;

  /* A single change request used to render as a full width blue
     bar with a 1 in it, which is a lot of ink for one number.
     Counts are counts: they go in chips, and only the ones with
     something in them are drawn. */
  data.changeStats = [
    { key: 'wait',  label: gs.getMessage('Awaiting a decision'), count: approval.requested },
    { key: 'good',  label: gs.getMessage('Approved'),            count: approval.approved },
    { key: 'bad',   label: gs.getMessage('Rejected'),            count: approval.rejected },
    { key: 'draft', label: gs.getMessage('Not yet requested'),   count: approval.notyet }
  ];

  data.hasChanges = apprTotal > 0;

  var catRows = [];
  for (var cn in byCategory) catRows.push({ label: cn, count: byCategory[cn] });
  catRows.sort(function (a, b) { return b.count - a.count; });

  var catTop = catRows.length ? catRows[0].count : 0;

  data.byCategory = [];
  for (var cr = 0; cr < catRows.length && cr < 5; cr++) {
    data.byCategory.push({
      label: catRows[cr].label,
      count: catRows[cr].count,
      width: catTop ? Math.max(8, Math.round((catRows[cr].count / catTop) * 100)) : 0
    });
  }

  /* ---------- tiles ---------- */
  var lastReport = data.reports.length ? data.reports[0] : null;
  var sinceReport = lastReport ? daysBetween(lastReport.rawDate, new GlideDateTime().getValue()) : null;

  data.tiles = [
    {
      key  : 'complete',
      label: gs.getMessage('Complete'),
      value: percent + '%',
      note : data.pressure
               ? data.pressure.elapsed + '% ' + gs.getMessage('of the schedule has gone')
               : gs.getMessage('no dates set, so no comparison')
    },
    {
      key  : 'reported',
      label: gs.getMessage('Last reported'),
      value: lastReport ? lastReport.date : '—',
      note : sinceReport === null
               ? gs.getMessage('nothing filed yet')
               : (sinceReport <= 1 ? gs.getMessage('today')
                                   : sinceReport + ' ' + gs.getMessage('days ago')),
      alert: sinceReport !== null && sinceReport > 45
    },
    {
      key  : 'money',
      label: gs.getMessage('Reimbursed'),
      value: short(claimValue.paid),
      note : (claimValue.submitted + claimValue.review)
               ? short(claimValue.submitted + claimValue.review) + ' ' + gs.getMessage('still awaiting a decision')
               : gs.getMessage('nothing waiting on a decision')
    },
    {
      key  : 'open',
      label: gs.getMessage('Open threads'),
      value: '' + (approval.requested + openRisks + openIssues),
      note : approval.requested + ' ' + gs.getMessage('changes') + ' · ' +
             openRisks + ' ' + gs.getMessage('risks') + ' · ' +
             openIssues + ' ' + gs.getMessage('issues'),
      alert: (approval.requested + openRisks + openIssues) > 0
    }
  ];

  data.counts = {
    reports: data.reports.length,
    changes: data.changes.length,
    claims : data.claims.length,
    risks  : data.risks.length,
    issues : data.issues.length
  };


  /* ============================================================
     COPY
     ============================================================ */

  data.t = {
    back    : gs.getMessage('Back to my projects'),
    missing : gs.getMessage('Project not available'),

    pressureTitle: gs.getMessage('Delivery against the calendar'),
    pressureHint : gs.getMessage('How much of the schedule has gone, against how much of the work is done'),
    pressureNone : gs.getMessage('Set a start and a planned end date on the project and this fills in.'),
    elapsed      : gs.getMessage('Schedule elapsed'),
    done         : gs.getMessage('Work complete'),
    planned      : gs.getMessage('measured from the planned start, since no actual start is set'),
    daysLeft     : gs.getMessage('days left'),
    daysOver     : gs.getMessage('days over'),

    stripTitle: gs.getMessage('Twelve months of reporting'),
    stripHint : gs.getMessage('One square per month, coloured by the health that report carried. An empty square means nothing was filed.'),

    progressTitle: gs.getMessage('Progress as reported'),
    progressHint : gs.getMessage('The percent complete claimed on each report, in order. A line that flattens is a project that stopped moving.'),
    progressNone : gs.getMessage('Two reports are needed before there is a line to draw.'),

    gridTitle: gs.getMessage('The report card'),
    gridHint : gs.getMessage('One row per report, one dot per rating. A column that keeps going amber is the one to read.'),
    gridNone : gs.getMessage('Nothing reported yet, so there is no card to show.'),
    gridTally: gs.getMessage('Times amber or red'),
    gridClean: gs.getMessage('always green'),

    riskProbability: gs.getMessage('Probability'),
    riskRank    : gs.getMessage('Risk rank'),
    riskStatus  : gs.getMessage('Risk status'),
    riskMitigation: gs.getMessage('Mitigation plan'),
    issuePriority: gs.getMessage('Priority'),
    due         : gs.getMessage('Due'),
    overdue     : gs.getMessage('overdue'),
    detail      : gs.getMessage('Description'),

    moneyTitle: gs.getMessage('Where the money is'),
    moneyHint : gs.getMessage('Every claim on this project, by the stage it has reached'),
    moneyNone : gs.getMessage('No claims raised on this project yet.'),

    changeTitle: gs.getMessage('Change requests'),
    changeHint : gs.getMessage('Where each one stands, and what you have asked to change'),
    changeNone : gs.getMessage('No change requests raised on this project yet.'),

    tabOverview: gs.getMessage('Overview'),
    tabReports : gs.getMessage('Status reports'),
    tabChanges : gs.getMessage('Change requests'),
    tabClaims  : gs.getMessage('Reimbursements'),
    tabRisks   : gs.getMessage('Risks'),
    tabIssues  : gs.getMessage('Issues'),

    program   : gs.getMessage('Program'),
    award     : gs.getMessage('Award'),
    application: gs.getMessage('Application'),
    manager   : gs.getMessage('Program manager'),
    phase     : gs.getMessage('Phase'),
    reference : gs.getMessage('Reference'),
    description: gs.getMessage('Description'),
    notes     : gs.getMessage('Notes'),

    dates       : gs.getMessage('Dates'),
    actualStart : gs.getMessage('Actual start'),
    plannedStart: gs.getMessage('Planned start'),
    actualEnd   : gs.getMessage('Actual end'),
    plannedEnd  : gs.getMessage('Planned end'),
    notSet      : gs.getMessage('Not set'),

    schedule : gs.getMessage('Schedule'),
    cost     : gs.getMessage('Cost'),
    resources: gs.getMessage('Resources'),
    scope    : gs.getMessage('Scope'),

    achieved : gs.getMessage('Achievements last month'),
    nextUp   : gs.getMessage('Key activities next month'),
    comments : gs.getMessage('Comments'),

    category : gs.getMessage('Category'),
    priority : gs.getMessage('Priority'),
    impact   : gs.getMessage('Impact'),
    proposed : gs.getMessage('Proposed change'),
    reason   : gs.getMessage('Reason for change'),

    amount : gs.getMessage('Amount'),

    open   : gs.getMessage('Open'),

    empty  : gs.getMessage('Nothing recorded'),
    emptyReports: gs.getMessage('No reports filed on this project yet.'),

    emptyClaims : gs.getMessage('No claims raised on this project yet.')
  };
