     GATENOW · EACH PROJECT DETAIL
     Service Portal widget · HTML template

     One project, everything hanging off it, and the three forms
     it can file. The forms open in place rather than on another
     page, because the analytics above them are the context for
     deciding what to write.
     ========================================================= -->

<div class="gpd">

  <!-- ═══════════════ NOT AVAILABLE ═══════════════ -->
  <div class="gpd-missing" ng-if="!c.data.found">
    <p class="gpd-missing__title">{{c.data.t.missing}}</p>

    <!-- The reason, rather than a shrug. Four different things
         produce this panel and they need four different
         responses, so the one that happened is stated. -->
    <p class="gpd-missing__why" ng-if="c.data.error">{{c.data.error}}</p>

    <button type="button" class="gpd-btn gpd-btn--ghost" ng-click="c.goBack()">
      {{c.data.t.back}}
    </button>
  </div>


  <!-- ═══════════════ THE PROJECT ═══════════════ -->
  <div ng-if="c.data.found">

    <!-- masthead -->
    <header class="gpd-top" ng-class="'gpd-top--' + c.data.project.health">

      <span class="gpd-top__edge" aria-hidden="true"></span>

      <button type="button" class="gpd-back" ng-click="c.goBack()">
        <span class="gpd-back__arrow" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="15" height="15" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
               stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M15 6l-6 6 6 6"></path>
          </svg>
        </span>
        {{c.data.t.back}}
      </button>

      <div class="gpd-top__row">

        <div class="gpd-top__lead">

          <span class="gpd-top__meta">
            <span class="gpd-health" ng-class="'gpd-health--' + c.data.project.health">
              <span class="gpd-health__dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>{{c.data.project.healthLabel}}
            </span>
            <span class="gpd-top__tags">
              <span ng-if="c.data.project.program">{{c.data.project.program}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-top__sep" ng-if="c.data.project.program" aria-hidden="true">·</span>
              <span>{{c.data.project.number}}</span>
            </span>
          </span>

          <h1 class="gpd-title">{{c.data.project.name}}</h1>
          <p class="gpd-lead" ng-if="c.data.project.description">{{c.data.project.description}}</p>

        </div>

      </div>

      <!-- phase -->
      <div class="gpd-phase" ng-class="{'is-stopped': c.data.project.phaseIndex === -1}">
        <div class="gpd-phase__step"
             ng-repeat="ph in c.data.phaseTrack track by $index"
             ng-class="{'is-done': $index < c.data.project.phaseIndex,
                        'is-now': $index === c.data.project.phaseIndex}">
          <span class="gpd-phase__bar" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <span class="gpd-phase__name">{{ph}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

    </header>


    <!-- tiles -->
    <section class="gpd-tiles">
      <article class="gpd-tile"
               ng-repeat="t in c.data.tiles track by t.key"
               ng-class="['gpd-tile--' + t.key, {'is-alert': t.alert}]">
        <span class="gpd-tile__rule" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <p class="gpd-tile__label">{{t.label}}</p>
        <p class="gpd-tile__value">{{t.value}}</p>
        <p class="gpd-tile__note">{{t.note}}</p>
      </article>
    </section>


    <!-- ═══════════════ SCHEDULE PRESSURE ═══════════════
         The one comparison a portfolio view cannot make. Fifteen
         percent complete is fine in month one and alarming in
         month eleven.
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <section class="gpd-panel gpd-panel--press" ng-class="c.data.pressure ? ('is-' + c.data.pressure.tone) : ''">

      <header class="gpd-panel__head">
        <div>
          <h2 class="gpd-panel__title">{{c.data.t.pressureTitle}}</h2>
          <p class="gpd-panel__hint">{{c.data.t.pressureHint}}</p>
        </div>
        <span class="gpd-verdict" ng-if="c.data.pressure">{{c.data.pressure.verdict}}</span>
      </header>

      <div class="gpd-press" ng-if="c.data.pressure">

        <div class="gpd-press__row">
          <span class="gpd-press__label">{{c.data.t.elapsed}}</span>
          <span class="gpd-press__track">
            <span class="gpd-press__fill gpd-press__fill--time"
                  ng-style="{width: c.data.pressure.elapsed + '%'}"></span>
          </span>
          <span class="gpd-press__pct">{{c.data.pressure.elapsed}}%</span>
        </div>

        <div class="gpd-press__row">
          <span class="gpd-press__label">{{c.data.t.done}}</span>
          <span class="gpd-press__track">
            <span class="gpd-press__fill gpd-press__fill--work"
                  ng-style="{width: c.data.pressure.done + '%'}"></span>
          </span>
          <span class="gpd-press__pct">{{c.data.pressure.done}}%</span>
        </div>

        <p class="gpd-press__foot">
          <span ng-if="c.data.pressure.daysLeft >= 0">
            {{c.data.pressure.daysLeft}} {{c.data.t.daysLeft}}
          </span>
          <span ng-if="c.data.pressure.daysLeft < 0">
            {{-c.data.pressure.daysLeft}} {{c.data.t.daysOver}}
          </span>
          <span ng-if="c.data.pressure.usedPlanned"> · {{c.data.t.planned}}</span>
        </p>

      </div>

      <p class="gpd-panel__empty" ng-if="!c.data.pressure">{{c.data.t.pressureNone}}</p>

    </section>


    <!-- ═══════════════ REPORTING ═══════════════ -->
    <section class="gpd-panels">

      <!-- twelve month strip -->
      <article class="gpd-panel">

        <header class="gpd-panel__head">
          <div>
            <h2 class="gpd-panel__title">{{c.data.t.stripTitle}}</h2>
            <p class="gpd-panel__hint">{{c.data.t.stripHint}}</p>
          </div>
        </header>

        <div class="gpd-strip">
          <div class="gpd-strip__cell" ng-repeat="m in c.data.strip track by $index">
            <span class="gpd-cell" ng-class="'gpd-cell--' + m.key" title="{{m.month}}"></span>
            <span class="gpd-strip__month">{{m.month}}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- progress as reported -->
        <h4 class="gpd-sub">{{c.data.t.progressTitle}}</h4>
        <p class="gpd-panel__hint gpd-panel__hint--tight">{{c.data.t.progressHint}}</p>

        <div class="gpd-line" ng-if="c.data.hasProgress">
          <span class="gpd-line__rule" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <span class="gpd-line__rule gpd-line__rule--mid" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <span class="gpd-line__rule gpd-line__rule--base" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <span class="gpd-dot"
                ng-repeat="p in c.data.progress track by $index"
                ng-class="'gpd-dot--' + p.health"
                ng-style="{left: p.x + '%', bottom: p.pct + '%'}"
                title="{{p.label}} · {{p.pct}}%"></span>
        </div>

        <p class="gpd-panel__empty" ng-if="!c.data.hasProgress">{{c.data.t.progressNone}}</p>

      </article>

      <!-- the report card -->
      <article class="gpd-panel">

        <header class="gpd-panel__head">
          <div>
            <h2 class="gpd-panel__title">{{c.data.t.gridTitle}}</h2>
            <p class="gpd-panel__hint">{{c.data.t.gridHint}}</p>
          </div>
        </header>

        <div class="gpd-card" ng-if="c.data.hasGrid">

          <div class="gpd-card__head">
            <span class="gpd-card__when"></span>
            <span class="gpd-card__col" ng-repeat="col in c.data.gridCols track by $index">{{col}}</span>
          </div>

          <div class="gpd-card__row" ng-repeat="row in c.data.grid track by $index">
            <span class="gpd-card__when">
              <span class="gpd-card__date">{{row.date}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-card__ref">{{row.number}}</span>
            </span>
            <span class="gpd-card__cell" ng-repeat="cell in row.cells track by $index">
              <span class="gpd-mark" ng-class="'gpd-mark--' + cell.key" title="{{cell.label}}"></span>
            </span>
          </div>

          <!-- counting dots is work the page can do for the
               reader. Green is not counted: nobody needs telling
               how often things were fine. -->
          <div class="gpd-card__row gpd-card__row--tally">
            <span class="gpd-card__when">{{c.data.t.gridTally}}</span>
            <span class="gpd-card__cell" ng-repeat="t in c.data.gridTally track by $index">
              <span class="gpd-count" ng-if="t.red" ng-class="'gpd-count--red'">{{t.red}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-count" ng-if="t.amber" ng-class="'gpd-count--amber'">{{t.amber}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-count gpd-count--clean" ng-if="t.clean">—</span>
            </span>
          </div>

        </div>

        <p class="gpd-verdict gpd-verdict--foot" ng-if="c.data.gridVerdict">{{c.data.gridVerdict}}</p>

        <p class="gpd-panel__empty" ng-if="!c.data.hasGrid">{{c.data.t.gridNone}}</p>

      </article>

    </section>


    <!-- ═══════════════ MONEY AND CHANGE ═══════════════ -->
    <section class="gpd-panels">

      <article class="gpd-panel">

        <header class="gpd-panel__head">
          <div>
            <h2 class="gpd-panel__title">{{c.data.t.moneyTitle}}</h2>
            <p class="gpd-panel__hint">{{c.data.t.moneyHint}}</p>
          </div>
          <span class="gpd-reject" ng-if="c.data.money.rejected">{{c.data.money.rejectedText}}</span>
        </header>

        <div class="gpd-pipe" ng-if="c.data.hasMoney">
          <div class="gpd-stage"
               ng-repeat="s in c.data.money.stages track by s.key"
               ng-class="['gpd-stage--' + s.key, {'is-empty': !s.count}]">
            <span class="gpd-stage__top">
              <span class="gpd-stage__label">{{s.label}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-stage__count">{{s.count}}</span>
            </span>
            <span class="gpd-stage__track">
              <span class="gpd-stage__fill" ng-style="{width: s.width + '%'}"></span>
            </span>
            <span class="gpd-stage__value">{{s.text}}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <p class="gpd-panel__empty" ng-if="!c.data.hasMoney">{{c.data.t.moneyNone}}</p>

      </article>

      <article class="gpd-panel">

        <header class="gpd-panel__head">
          <div>
            <h2 class="gpd-panel__title">{{c.data.t.changeTitle}}</h2>
            <p class="gpd-panel__hint">{{c.data.t.changeHint}}</p>
          </div>
        </header>

        <div ng-if="c.data.hasChanges">

          <ul class="gpd-stats">
            <li ng-repeat="st in c.changeStats() track by st.key"
                ng-class="'gpd-stats--' + st.key">
              <span class="gpd-stats__n">{{st.count}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-stats__label">{{st.label}}</span>
            </li>
          </ul>

          <div class="gpd-bars">
            <div class="gpd-bar"
                 ng-repeat="b in c.data.byCategory track by $index"
                 ng-class="'gpd-bar--' + ($index + 1)">
              <span class="gpd-bar__name">{{b.label}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-bar__track">
                <span class="gpd-bar__fill" ng-style="{width: b.width + '%'}"></span>
              </span>
              <span class="gpd-bar__count">{{b.count}}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>

        <p class="gpd-panel__empty" ng-if="!c.data.hasChanges">{{c.data.t.changeNone}}</p>

      </article>

    </section>


    <!-- ═══════════════ RELATED RECORDS ═══════════════ -->
    <section class="gpd-block">

      <!-- ng-repeat and ng-if were on the same element here,
           each making its own child scope, and the click that
           assigned c.tab from inside that pair did not take.
           The list is filtered in the controller now and the
           switch goes through setTab. -->
      <nav class="gpd-tabs" role="tablist">
        <button type="button"
                class="gpd-tab"
                ng-repeat="t in c.tabs track by t.key"
                ng-class="{'is-on': c.isTab(t.key)}"
                ng-click="c.setTab(t.key)"
                role="tab"
                ng-attr-aria-selected="{{c.isTab(t.key)}}">
          <span class="gpd-tab__label">{{t.label}}</span>
          <span class="gpd-tab__n" ng-if="t.count()">{{t.count()}}</span>
        </button>
      </nav>

      <div class="gpd-block__body">

        <!-- overview -->
        <div ng-if="c.isTab('overview')">

          <dl class="gpd-kvs">
            <div class="gpd-kv"><dt>{{c.data.t.program}}</dt>
              <dd ng-class="{'is-blank': !c.data.project.program}">{{c.data.project.program || c.data.t.none}}</dd></div>
            <div class="gpd-kv"><dt>{{c.data.t.award}}</dt>
              <dd ng-class="{'is-blank': !c.data.project.award}">{{c.data.project.award || c.data.t.none}}</dd></div>
            <div class="gpd-kv"><dt>{{c.data.t.application}}</dt>
              <dd ng-class="{'is-blank': !c.data.project.applicant}">{{c.data.project.applicant || c.data.t.none}}</dd></div>
            <div class="gpd-kv"><dt>{{c.data.t.manager}}</dt>
              <dd ng-class="{'is-blank': !c.data.project.manager}">{{c.data.project.manager || c.data.t.none}}</dd></div>
            <div class="gpd-kv"><dt>{{c.data.t.phase}}</dt><dd>{{c.data.project.phase}}</dd></div>
            <div class="gpd-kv"><dt>{{c.data.t.reference}}</dt><dd>{{c.data.project.number}}</dd></div>
          </dl>

          <h4 class="gpd-sub">{{c.data.t.dates}}</h4>

          <dl class="gpd-kvs">
            <div class="gpd-kv"><dt>{{c.data.t.actualStart}}</dt>
              <dd ng-class="{'is-blank': !c.data.project.actualStart}">{{c.data.project.actualStart || c.data.t.notSet}}</dd></div>
            <div class="gpd-kv"><dt>{{c.data.t.plannedStart}}</dt>
              <dd ng-class="{'is-blank': !c.data.project.plannedStart}">{{c.data.project.plannedStart || c.data.t.notSet}}</dd></div>
            <div class="gpd-kv"><dt>{{c.data.t.actualEnd}}</dt>
              <dd ng-class="{'is-blank': !c.data.project.actualEnd}">{{c.data.project.actualEnd || c.data.t.notSet}}</dd></div>
            <div class="gpd-kv"><dt>{{c.data.t.plannedEnd}}</dt>
              <dd ng-class="{'is-blank': !c.data.project.plannedEnd}">{{c.data.project.plannedEnd || c.data.t.notSet}}</dd></div>
          </dl>

          <div class="gpd-prose" ng-if="c.data.project.notes">
            <p class="gpd-prose__label">{{c.data.t.notes}}</p>
            <p class="gpd-prose__text">{{c.data.project.notes}}</p>
          </div>

        </div>

        <!-- status reports -->
        <div ng-if="c.isTab('reports')">

          <article class="gpd-report" ng-repeat="r in c.data.reports track by r.sysId">

            <header class="gpd-report__head">
              <span class="gpd-report__num">{{r.number}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-report__type" ng-if="r.type">{{r.type}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-report__date">{{r.date}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-report__pct">{{r.percent}}%</span>
              <span class="gpd-health gpd-health--sm" ng-class="'gpd-health--' + r.health.key">
                <span class="gpd-health__dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>{{r.health.label}}
              </span>
            </header>

            <div class="gpd-rag">
              <span class="gpd-rag__item" ng-class="'gpd-rag__item--' + r.schedule.key">
                <span class="gpd-rag__label">{{c.data.t.schedule}}</span>
                <span class="gpd-rag__value">{{r.schedule.label}}</span>
              </span>
              <span class="gpd-rag__item" ng-class="'gpd-rag__item--' + r.cost.key">
                <span class="gpd-rag__label">{{c.data.t.cost}}</span>
                <span class="gpd-rag__value">{{r.cost.label}}</span>
              </span>
              <span class="gpd-rag__item" ng-class="'gpd-rag__item--' + r.resources.key">
                <span class="gpd-rag__label">{{c.data.t.resources}}</span>
                <span class="gpd-rag__value">{{r.resources.label}}</span>
              </span>
              <span class="gpd-rag__item" ng-class="'gpd-rag__item--' + r.scope.key">
                <span class="gpd-rag__label">{{c.data.t.scope}}</span>
                <span class="gpd-rag__value">{{r.scope.label}}</span>
              </span>
            </div>

            <div class="gpd-prose" ng-repeat="pr in c.reportProse(r) track by $index">
              <p class="gpd-prose__label">{{pr.label}}</p>
              <p class="gpd-prose__text">{{pr.value}}</p>
            </div>

          </article>

          <p class="gpd-empty" ng-if="!c.data.reports.length">{{c.data.t.emptyReports}}</p>

        </div>

        <!-- change requests -->
        <div ng-if="c.isTab('changes')">

          <article class="gpd-item" ng-repeat="ch in c.data.changes track by ch.sysId">
            <header class="gpd-item__head">
              <span class="gpd-item__num">{{ch.number}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-pill" ng-class="'gpd-pill--' + ch.state">{{ch.approval || c.data.t.none}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-item__date">{{ch.raised}}</span>
            </header>
            <p class="gpd-item__title" ng-if="ch.title">{{ch.title}}</p>
            <p class="gpd-item__meta">
              <span ng-if="ch.category">{{c.data.t.category}}: <strong>{{ch.category}}</strong></span>
              <span ng-if="ch.priority">{{c.data.t.priority}}: <strong>{{ch.priority}}</strong></span>
              <span ng-if="ch.impact">{{c.data.t.impact}}: <strong>{{ch.impact}}</strong></span>
            </p>
            <div class="gpd-prose" ng-if="ch.proposed">
              <p class="gpd-prose__label">{{c.data.t.proposed}}</p>
              <p class="gpd-prose__text">{{ch.proposed}}</p>
            </div>
            <div class="gpd-prose" ng-if="ch.reason">
              <p class="gpd-prose__label">{{c.data.t.reason}}</p>
              <p class="gpd-prose__text">{{ch.reason}}</p>
            </div>
          </article>

          <p class="gpd-empty" ng-if="!c.data.changes.length">{{c.data.t.emptyChanges}}</p>

        </div>

        <!-- reimbursements -->
        <div ng-if="c.isTab('claims')">

          <article class="gpd-item" ng-repeat="cl in c.data.claims track by cl.sysId">
            <header class="gpd-item__head">
              <span class="gpd-item__num">{{cl.number}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-pill" ng-class="'gpd-pill--' + cl.state">{{cl.status}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-item__amount">{{cl.amountText}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-item__date">{{cl.raised}}</span>
            </header>
            <p class="gpd-item__meta" ng-if="cl.from || cl.to">
              {{c.data.t.period}}: <strong>{{cl.from || '—'}} – {{cl.to || '—'}}</strong>
            </p>
            <p class="gpd-item__text" ng-if="cl.summary">{{cl.summary}}</p>
          </article>

          <p class="gpd-empty" ng-if="!c.data.claims.length">{{c.data.t.emptyClaims}}</p>

        </div>

        <!-- risks -->
        <div ng-if="c.isTab('risks')">

          <article class="gpd-item" ng-repeat="rk in c.data.risks track by rk.sysId">

            <header class="gpd-item__head">
              <span class="gpd-item__num">{{rk.number}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-pill" ng-class="rk.open ? 'gpd-pill--wait' : 'gpd-pill--good'">
                {{rk.status || (rk.open ? c.data.t.open : c.data.t.closed)}}
              </span>
              <span class="gpd-flag" ng-if="rk.overdue">{{c.data.t.overdue}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-item__date">{{rk.raised}}</span>
            </header>

            <p class="gpd-item__title" ng-if="rk.title">{{rk.title}}</p>

            <dl class="gpd-facts">
              <div class="gpd-fact" ng-if="rk.probability">
                <dt>{{c.data.t.riskProbability}}</dt><dd>{{rk.probability}}</dd>
              </div>
              <div class="gpd-fact" ng-if="rk.impact">
                <dt>{{c.data.t.impact}}</dt><dd>{{rk.impact}}</dd>
              </div>
              <div class="gpd-fact" ng-if="rk.rank">
                <dt>{{c.data.t.riskRank}}</dt><dd>{{rk.rank}}</dd>
              </div>
              <div class="gpd-fact" ng-if="rk.due">
                <dt>{{c.data.t.due}}</dt>
                <dd ng-class="{'is-late': rk.overdue}">{{rk.due}}</dd>
              </div>
            </dl>

            <div class="gpd-prose" ng-if="rk.detail">
              <p class="gpd-prose__label">{{c.data.t.detail}}</p>
              <p class="gpd-prose__text">{{rk.detail}}</p>
            </div>

            <div class="gpd-prose" ng-if="rk.mitigation">
              <p class="gpd-prose__label">{{c.data.t.riskMitigation}}</p>
              <p class="gpd-prose__text">{{rk.mitigation}}</p>
            </div>

          </article>

          <p class="gpd-empty" ng-if="!c.data.risks.length">{{c.data.t.empty}}</p>

        </div>

        <!-- issues -->
        <div ng-if="c.isTab('issues')">

          <article class="gpd-item" ng-repeat="is in c.data.issues track by is.sysId">

            <header class="gpd-item__head">
              <span class="gpd-item__num">{{is.number}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-pill" ng-class="is.open ? 'gpd-pill--wait' : 'gpd-pill--good'">
                {{is.status || (is.open ? c.data.t.open : c.data.t.closed)}}
              </span>
              <span class="gpd-flag" ng-if="is.overdue">{{c.data.t.overdue}}</span>
              <span class="gpd-item__date">{{is.raised}}</span>
            </header>

            <p class="gpd-item__title" ng-if="is.title">{{is.title}}</p>

            <dl class="gpd-facts">
              <div class="gpd-fact" ng-if="is.priority">
                <dt>{{c.data.t.issuePriority}}</dt><dd>{{is.priority}}</dd>
              </div>
              <div class="gpd-fact" ng-if="is.impact">
                <dt>{{c.data.t.impact}}</dt><dd>{{is.impact}}</dd>
              </div>
              <div class="gpd-fact" ng-if="is.due">
                <dt>{{c.data.t.due}}</dt>
                <dd ng-class="{'is-late': is.overdue}">{{is.due}}</dd>
              </div>
            </dl>

            <div class="gpd-prose" ng-if="is.detail">
              <p class="gpd-prose__label">{{c.data.t.detail}}</p>
              <p class="gpd-prose__text">{{is.detail}}</p>
            </div>

          </article>

          <p class="gpd-empty" ng-if="!c.data.issues.length">{{c.data.t.empty}}</p>

        </div>

      </div>

    </section>

  </div>

</div>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>
